scope: Five existing full-size slide PNGs reviewed specifically for native presentation composition. This does not replace the earlier all-slide review or clear its outstanding defects.

slides.observation: Open numbered rows and thin rules organize the executive summary; no enclosing UI cards.
Flat process rows use numbered blocks with semantic sequence; text remains open on the slide canvas.
Three phase columns include dates, gates and actions; coloured headers group actual phases, not simulated interactive tabs.
Large chart with unboxed KPI and timeline supports the headline; no decorative dashboard shell.
Chart dominates; two modest KPI groups and a dated sequence provide relevant support. The grouping is not itself a UI-style defect.

object_inspection.limitation: Charts in the inspected quantitative PPTX are image/SVG objects, not editable Office charts. Native-looking composition and object editability are separate criteria.

changes: Authoring and manual visual-review guidance only; no generator or existing deck changes. No new web-UI-style defect confirmed in the five samples.
